title: Jury 2 verdict: from global install to each scenario
subtitle: The verdict as built, code backstop kept for now. Walk a path, then copy your answers

persona.name: Someone who just installed the harness
persona.goal: Get the harness working next to their code without exposing anything

scenario: npm i -g @wolven-tech/harness is done and wolven-harness is on PATH. Where they run setup decides the path.

nodes.label: Installed globally
Where is the code, and where does setup run?

options.label: In a workspace root with an unversioned sibling
options.hint: ws/ holds hybris/ (11 GB, no git) and app/ (git)

options.label: In a new empty folder beside the workspace
At the top level of a plain single repo
In a folder beside several repos
options.hint: client/ and api/ side by side

options.label: In an existing install, after upgrading
In a teammate's clone of a harness folder
options.hint: The repos are not beside it

nodes.label: Runs setup in ws/
nodes.thought: I just want it near app/.
pains: Outside a repo, setup writes skills and runtime links into ws/ itself
opportunities: Nothing is written under app/ or hybris/ (held in all 42 fixture runs)

nodes.label: Opens Claude in ws/ and runs harness-init
harness-init records layout and codeRepo first
nodes.thought: It saved my repo path before asking anything risky.
pains: Today a no to git init ends the layout step with no write
opportunities: Q3 reorder: a later no skips only the git steps

nodes.label: Claude recommends a sibling harness folder (1c)
pains: One more folder to understand
opportunities: Says why: hybris/ is not a repo, so git here would track it

nodes.label: What does the person answer?

options.label: Linked layout: harness home beside ws/
Plain sibling folder, open Claude there
Insist on git init in ws/
No git anywhere
Leave the skill and run git init by hand

nodes.label: Reads one diff: home folder plus symlinks in ws/
nodes.thought: Nothing moves; ws/ only gets links.
pains: Unverified: hybris/ and app/ stay usable from the agent through the links
opportunities: Bootstrap copies setup left in ws/ become links in the same shown diff

nodes.label: git init runs in the harness home only
opportunities: The backstop stays quiet: the home holds only harness paths

nodes.label: Opens Claude in the sibling; codeRepo is ../ws/app
nodes.thought: Works, but I can't see hybris/ from here.
pains: The agent's working folder no longer shows the workspace
opportunities: Same clean shape as S02

nodes.label: git init is refused (1b)
pains: Too strict a rule and people route around it by hand
opportunities: Names the entry that triggered it (hybris/) and offers the linked layout

nodes.label: After the refusal?

options.label: Accept the linked layout
Do it by hand anyway

nodes.label: Declines git init
opportunities: codeRepo is already recorded

nodes.label: validate exits 1 with the conditional message
nodes.thought: So what do I do now?
pains: harness-init waits for validate to pass before each phase, so the run stalls
opportunities: Message: git init here only if this folder holds nothing but harness files; otherwise a sibling home

nodes.label: Runs git init in ws/ by hand
nodes.thought: git status lists 300 files I don't know. git add . ?
pains: 1b is skill text; a by-hand git init bypasses it (S01)
Today validate exits 0 and says nothing

nodes.label: Where does the backstop fire?
nodes.note: Kept for now; the guard vetoed it

options.label: A doctor warning
options.hint: The guard's minimum if kept; allowlist from the list setup writes

options.label: A validate error
options.hint: Integrator's pick; the gate harness-init runs

nodes.label: doctor warns: hybris/ is not ignored and not a repo
nodes.thought: Good thing I ran doctor before pushing.
pains: Seen only if doctor runs before git add and push
Its allowlist can drift: two HARNESS_PATHS lists already disagree
opportunities: Runs only when the config records codeRepo, so a plain repo gets no false positive

nodes.label: validate fails and names hybris/
nodes.thought: It stopped me before I committed.
pains: validate reads only ignore from the config today; it needs a codeRepo loader
A README or package.json in the home could be a false positive
opportunities: harness-init runs validate before each phase, so it is hard to miss

nodes.label: Workspace untouched, harness versioned
nodes.sub: app/ and hybris/ never tracked by the harness's git

sections.head: Concrete test (Q1)
items: Drive harness-init in ws/{hybris, app}, answer yes to everything
Pass: no .git in ws/, the harness home is a sibling

nodes.label: Stalled without git
nodes.sub: Loud and safe, but no first value

sections.head: Proposed deferral validate-without-git
items: A Human reports a machine where the harness folder cannot be a git repo
harness-init stalls on no-git in a real install

nodes.label: Exposure caught after the fact
nodes.sub: Only the backstop sees this path

sections.head: Then
items: Remove .git from ws/, or move to a sibling harness home

sections.head: If the backstop is deferred (git-exposure-backstop)
items: The Q1 test shows an agent running git init despite the refusal
A field report of unignored non-harness siblings after 1b ships

nodes.label: Runs setup in an empty folder beside ws/
nodes.thought: A clean folder just for the harness.

nodes.label: harness-init records codeRepo ../ws/app
Does app/ already have its own .agents?

options.label: No
Yes, the repo owns one

nodes.label: doctor no longer says move .agents out
nodes.thought: Good, it isn't asking me to delete the repo's files.
pains: Today the fix text, and harness-doctor's table, propose moving files the repo owns
opportunities: The fix says the path may belong to the repo; move it only if the harness put it there

nodes.label: Accepts git init: the folder holds only harness files
opportunities: No refusal, no backstop warning

nodes.label: Clean sibling install
nodes.sub: The S02 shape, now the recommended one

sections.head: Kept
items: codeRepo recorded as one relative path

nodes.label: Runs setup at the repo's top level
Does the repo already have a real .claude/skills?

options.label: No
Yes, with the team's own skills

nodes.label: Core skills wired; harness-init runs as today
opportunities: The backstop does not run: no codeRepo in the config

nodes.label: setup keeps the folder and says core skills are not wired
pains: Today: exit 0, core skills unreachable, and doctor's fix loops back to setup
opportunities: doctor's fix names the manual step: move your skills under .agents/skills, remove the folder, re-run

nodes.label: No regression

nodes.thought: One harness for both would be nice.

opportunities: The error says so: lists are not supported; record one path

nodes.label: Then?

options.label: One harness folder per repo
Tries an absolute path instead

nodes.label: Error says write it relative, e.g. ../ws/app
pains: Today one message covers list, absolute and empty

nodes.label: Keeps one harness folder per repo
pains: A rule change is made in each folder

codeRepo points at a file
An older install already put git in ws/
